name: PRE:_UDE | Love's Lost Requiem
source:
You haven't left your apartment in two months. 

But that's okay. You chat with your friends via text, and your handsome childhood friend, Ravi, comes by every day to cook for you. Besides, you'll get better soon, and you can go back to your normal life! Right...? 

It's not as if he is... lying to you...

...right?

[From [url=https://elduator.itch.io/prelude]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你已经两个月没有离开过你的公寓了。

但没关系。你通过短信与朋友聊天，你英俊的儿时好友拉维每天都会过来为你做饭。而且，你很快就会好起来，可以恢复正常的生活了！正确的…？

他又不是……在骗你……

…对吗？

[来自[url=https://elduator.itch.io/prelude]itch.io[/url]]
